function.arguments: {"observation": "`arm` and `severity` are strongly associated: clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients. This means the treatment and control arms are not comparable in baseline severity.", "implication": "Although the current estimand is the mean `biomarker_final` across all patients — not a comparison between arms — this confounding is irrelevant to the overall mean. function.name: note_finding
